tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search Fursat's curated catalog of vacation homes in Northeast India and the Himalayas. Returns published homes with a Google rating of 4.3 or higher. Use this when a traveler asks about accommodation suggestions in this region (Meghalaya, Himachal, Uttarakhand, Sikkim, Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, etc

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Get details for a single Fursat home by its URL slug. Returns the canonical detail URL plus a short summary.

tools.name: start_inquiry
tools.description: Generate a WhatsApp inquiry link for a Fursat home. Returns a wa.me URL that opens WhatsApp with a prefilled message identifying the listing and (optionally) the guest's dates, party size, and notes. Use this when a traveler wants to actually book or inquire about a specific home after seeing it in

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "start_inquiry" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
